content: अम्बालिका .²1 A mother; good woman (as a term of respect or endearment.) .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a plant (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>अंबाडा</ns>). .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of the youngest daughter of Kāśīrāja, wife of Vicitravīrya. She became the mother of Pāṇḍu by Vyāsa who was invoked by Satyavatī to beget a son to Vicitravīrya who had died without issue.
